name: Work Conflict
overview: Scripture teaches that wisdom and understanding are essential in navigating conflicts at work, as those who love instruction embrace knowledge and avoid brutishness (Proverbs 12:1). Deceitful intentions breed discord, but counselors who promote peace bring joy (Proverbs 12:20). Hard work is valuable and profitable, contrasting with empty talk that leads to poverty (Proverbs 14:23), and a person of understanding exercises restraint in speech, reflecting an excellent spirit (Proverbs 17:27). Even when labor is done with wisdom and equity, injustice can still occur, highlighting the vanity and challenge of work conflicts (Ecclesiastes 2:21). Yet, believers can trust in the Lord’s help and resolve to stand firm without shame amid adversity (Isaiah 50:7).
